evidence.title: AI 確實能幫品牌省下九成的成本，但它不該成為逃避道德與法律的藉口。
evidence.text:
AI 確實能幫品牌省下九成的成本，但它不該成為逃避道德與法律的藉口。

看到 Life 8 這次未經授權使用模特兒 Galin 肖像權的新聞，感觸滿深的。我自己也是做時尚 AI 新創的，我常常在想，技術在往前走的同時，我們怎麼不把創作者和模特兒的權益拋在後頭？

在國外像是歐美，其實已經開始制定相關的 AI 肖像規範了。這也是為什麼我們團隊這一年一直在推 mirror mirror 這個項目，因為我們想建立一個健康的AI使用的生態。

任何生圖前，品牌都必須先徵得模特兒允許、給予報酬，甚至生圖後還要核准。這樣一來，模特兒在實體拍攝之餘，還能用數位分身多一份被動收入。

我們目前已經跟不少模特兒合作、幫他們數位化了。

面對科技的衝擊，我們需要的是更完善的規範，而不是盲目的濫用。

evidence.title: SUN Podcast | From Construction Engineer to Microsoft SWE to AI Founder - Adalia Zhao
evidence.text:
SUN Podcast | From Construction Engineer to Microsoft SWE to AI Founder - Adalia Zhao

Adalia took an unconventional path from construction project management to becoming a self-taught software engineer at Microsoft, and ultimately the founder of BuildTrace, an AI company transforming how construction teams manage critical project data.

In this conversation, we explore Adalia’s journey from University of California, Berkeley and the construction field to Microsoft, what inspired her to build BuildTrace, and why the construction industry represents such a significant opportunity for AI.

We discuss:
• How Adalia taught herself software engineering
• Lessons from four years at Microsoft
• Why construction remains underserved by technology
• The gap Adalia discovered in construction AI
• Protecting sensitive project and customer data
• Building an AI startup with deep industry knowledge
• Advice for operators making an unconventional career transition

More incredible guests are coming soon. 

Who should I invite next? Tag them in the comments.

#ArtificialIntelligence #ConstructionTech #StartupFounder #Microsoft #Entrepreneurship #BuildTrace
